news_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_EC.30
	title = COLDWAR_EC.30.t
	desc = COLDWAR_EC.30.d
	picture = GFX_news_Italian_EU_Flags

	is_triggered_only = yes

	# the next news from the queue (COLDWAR_EC_news)
	immediate = {
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_nq_item^num > 0 } }
				set_variable = { cwec_n_item = cwec_nq_item^0 }
				remove_from_array = { array = cwec_nq_item index = 0 }
				set_variable = { cwec_n_res = cwec_nq_res^0 }
				remove_from_array = { array = cwec_nq_res index = 0 }
				set_variable = { cwec_n_target = cwec_nq_target^0 }
				remove_from_array = { array = cwec_nq_target index = 0 }
				set_variable = { cwec_n_by = cwec_nq_by^0 }
				remove_from_array = { array = cwec_nq_by index = 0 }
				set_variable = { cwec_n_who = cwec_nq_who^0 }
				remove_from_array = { array = cwec_nq_who index = 0 }
				set_variable = { cwec_n_a = cwec_nq_a^0 }
				remove_from_array = { array = cwec_nq_a index = 0 }
				set_variable = { cwec_n_b = cwec_nq_b^0 }
				remove_from_array = { array = cwec_nq_b index = 0 }
				set_variable = { cwec_n_c = cwec_nq_c^0 }
				remove_from_array = { array = cwec_nq_c index = 0 }
				set_variable = { cwec_n_d = cwec_nq_d^0 }
				remove_from_array = { array = cwec_nq_d index = 0 }
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_EC.news_ok
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_EC.30"
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_nq_item^num > 0 } }
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_EC_news_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
				news_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.30 }
			}
			else = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_news_busy }
		}
	}
